Hi Rachel —

Quick replies inline:  

1) Temporary S3 access: Yes. We can provision a time-bound, read-only presigned URL set that points at a staging prefix in our ingestion bucket. It’s preferable to avoid giving broad IAM roles. I’ve sketched two options:
  - Option A: Short-lived presigned objects for individual files (recommended for smaller batches).
  - Option B: A presigned POST for a single staging prefix combined with a limited-listing token for your auditors (useful if you’re handing over many files).

2) CAIQ mapping: I’m attaching a draft mapping (caiaq-field-mapping-draft.xlsx) and a suggested normalization sheet — we’ll consume the following formats: PDF, PNG, and plain text. For structured answers, prefer CSV or XLSX with the CAIQ control id in the first column.

Action items I propose:
  - We provision a presigned prefix for your staging window (start: 2027-12-10T00:00Z, end: 2027-12-13T00:00Z) and share instructions.
  - Greenleaf confirms the lead (you) and the SRE who will coordinate uploads.
  - We do a 30-min pre-ingest runbook walkthrough the week prior.

I’ll loop in Vivek (platform) to scope the presigned policy.

Thanks —
Mina
Senior Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick technical note — we should do Option B (presigned POST for a prefix) but lock the listing to a generated prefix token and expire the prefix after the window. Draft policy attached (s3-temporary-policy.json). Two specifics:

- Max object size: 250MB per object; we’ll reject files larger than that at upload time.
- Retention: Redwood will stage the objects for 72 hours after the window closes before automatic purge; Greenleaf should confirm any evidence that must be retained longer.

I’m comfortable with the window Mina suggested but recommend we start the prefix 12 hours earlier to allow a smoke test.

Vivek
